steps.note: Open the Events list to reach saved drafts.
Enable eRFX projects for the draft flow.
Apply the setting whose effect on the Savings control is under test.
Apply the additional company configuration specified by the case.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the saved drafts view specified by the case.
Open the first saved draft shown in the Drafts tab.
Assert that Savings is not offered on the saved eRFX draft.
